'''Cryo units'''<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> or '''cryogenic stasis units'''<ref name="AP">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref> were large devices that could be installed into [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] cargo holds. They were capable of keeping [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] fresh during transport.<ref name="PSG" />
